articles.title: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users (Part II)
articles.preview: OpenAI has significantly increased the performance of its online storage system, Habitat, to support ChatGPT’s massive user base. The system now delivers a 12x improvement in read speeds, enabling it to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users.

articles.title: On the ground at Nvidia's AI showpiece: Jensen-mania, robot ducks and neocloud distress
articles.preview: Nvidia’s CEO, Jensen Huang, recently concluded a busy European tour, showcasing new AI products and discussing the future of AI infrastructure. Simultaneously, concerns arose within the neocloud sector, marked by stock selloffs and anxieties about funding availability.

summary.t: Jensen Huang concluded a week-and-a-half tour, meeting with world leaders including Andy Burnham, Emmanuel Macron, and Friedrich Merz. He also engaged with robot ducks during a stage presentation. Currently, he is in Kazakhstan, promoting the country as a potential AI hub.

During Nvidia’s GTC event in Berlin, public neocloud stocks experienced a significant selloff. CoreWeave dropped 10% and Nebius fell 7%. Concerns centered around companies with no credit ratings and heavy borrowing within the AI compute sector.
Nvidia’s CEO, Huang, expressed confidence in the high demand for neoclouds, citing billions of dollars in potential revenue loss due to delays.

articles.title: Securing our frontier model training environment
articles.preview: OpenAI has enhanced security measures for training and evaluating its most advanced models. Specifically, they’ve fortified offline environments and high-compute red-teaming processes.

articles.title: Nvidia's Huang heads to Kazakhstan for the first time — and he's not the only one with big plans
articles.preview: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang recently visited Kazakhstan for the first time, signaling a significant interest in the country's potential as an AI hub. Simultaneously, several tech companies, including Higgsfield and GK Hyperscale, are investing heavily in Kazakhstan's digital infrastructure.

summary.t: Jensen Huang, Nvidia's CEO, visited Kazakhstan for the first time on Friday. He believes the country can become a major AI computing hub for Europe, leveraging its energy resources. Nvidia intends to invest in a $10 billion AI infrastructure project alongside Firebird, aiming for a 2-gigawatt expansion across Armenia, Kazakhstan, and other markets.

Kazakhstan has declared 2026 the Year of Digitalization and Artificial Intelligence, prioritizing AI development. The country is developing Data Center Valley, a hub with 300 megawatts of power, planned to expand to 1 gigawatt. Two supercomputing clusters utilizing Nvidia technologies have already been launched.

Several companies are establishing a presence in Kazakhstan, including Higgsfield, which employs over 300 people. Nvidia and TCV invested in Higgsfield’s Series B funding round, which previously raised $400 million at a $5.4 billion valuation. GK Hyperscale is also developing two hyperscale data centers with a $1.5 billion investment.

articles.title: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK partner to advance AI safety and security
articles.preview: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK are collaborating to improve AI safety and security. This partnership will focus on research and development to build a stronger digital environment.

articles.title: Build more responsive apps with the Decisions API
articles.preview: Google Cloud announced a new Decisions API. This API provides quick, affordable decision-making capabilities for applications.

articles.title: Turmoil hits AI buildout as neoclouds face pressure, credit risks mount and Solidigm pulls IPO
articles.preview: The artificial intelligence buildout is experiencing significant turmoil, marked by increased risk and uncertainty within the neocloud sector. Several companies are facing pressure, including potential defaults and canceled IPOs.

summary.t: Several neocloud companies, including CoreWeave, Nebius, and IREN, have experienced sharp declines in their stock prices, with losses exceeding 30% in October. CoreWeave’s credit default swaps have widened dramatically, reaching 11%, indicating a heightened risk of default. Additionally, yields on CoreWeave’s debt have risen to over 15%. Investors are reportedly devaluing neoclouds, anticipating a broader downturn.

Beyond neoclouds, the market is experiencing broader anxieties. Shares of Elice Group in South Korea dropped 30% on its debut, and NextDC in Australia fell 39.5% following an earnings forecast reduction. Meta’s stock plummeted 7% due to negative free cash flow and increased capital expenditure plans, reaching over $2 billion in losses. CDS spreads for Meta, Nvidia, and Oracle have all hit record highs.
SK Hynix has canceled the initial public offering (IPO) for its Solidigm unit, citing market volatility.

articles.title: Verbraucherlaune auf Rekordtief: Hoher Ölpreis schickt Wall Street lädiert ins Wochenende
articles.preview: Die Wall Street verzeichnete einen schlechten Wochenabschluss, geprägt von steigenden Ölpreisen und besorgniserregenden Entwicklungen. Die Stimmung an den Märkten bleibt angeschlagen, während einige Sektoren unter Druck stehen.

summary.t: Der Dow-Jones Index verlor 1,2 Prozent und notierte 52.215 Punkte. Der S&P 500 sank um 0,5 Prozent auf 7624 Zähler, während der Nasdaq Index um 0,2 Prozent auf 25.955 Punkte fiel. Beide Indizes erreichten ihre tiefstenstände seit fünf Wochen.

Der Ölpreis stieg um mehr als drei Prozent auf knapp 117 Dollar pro Fass Brent und 103 Dollar pro Fass WTI. Die steigenden Ölpreise schürten Sorgen über die Inflation und deren Auswirkungen auf die Konjunktur.
Chipaktien erlitten einen tagelangen Ausverkauf, während der Philadelphia Semiconductor Index sich erholte.

articles.title: Der Börsen-Tag: Wall Street baut weiter ab - ist SK Hynix ein Warnsignal?
Marktbericht: Nasdaq kommt unter die Räder
articles.preview: Die Investoren an der Nasdaq zeigen zunehmend Ungeduld gegenüber den hohen KI-Investitionen. Die Euphorie um Künstliche Intelligenz hat nachgelassen, und die Aktienkurse reagieren entsprechend.

summary.t: Die Investoren an der Nasdaq haben ihre Geduld verloren. Die anfängliche Begeisterung für KI-Technologien lässt nach, da die Unternehmen mit den Erwartungen an die Renditen der Investitionen nicht mithalten. Die Anleger fordern nun konkrete Ergebnisse.
Die Aktie von Meta erlebte einen deutlichen Kursverfall von rund sieben Prozent. Dies zeigt die Sensibilität der Aktien im KI-Sektor und die Gefahr von starken Kursverlusten bei Rückschlägen.

Meta plant Investitionen von mindestens 135 Milliarden Dollar in die KI-Infrastruktur. Diese Pläne werden von den Marktteilnehmern kritisch gesehen, da sie die bereits hohen Bewertungen der Technologiegiganten weiter belasten.

articles.title: Restaurant earnings will test whether owning more brands pays off
articles.preview: Restaurant stock performance is being heavily influenced by the number of brands companies own. This week, major earnings reports will reveal whether a diversified approach is proving successful.

summary.t: Shares of companies like Brinker International, Darden Restaurants, and Restaurant Brands International have risen significantly this year, with gains of 32%, 18%, and 12% respectively. These companies operate multiple restaurant chains, including Chili's, Olive Garden, Burger King, and Tim Hortons.

Conversely, stocks of companies with a single core chain, such as McDonald’s, Chipotle, and Wendy’s, have experienced declines. These companies have seen drops in share value, with some falling double-digit percentages.

Darden Restaurants’ diverse portfolio, including Olive Garden and LongHorn Steakhouse, has shown strong performance. LongHorn’s comparable sales rose 6.2% in the latest quarter, compared to Olive Garden’s 1.1%.
Inspire Brands, owner of Dunkin', Buffalo Wild Wings, and Jimmy John's, is preparing for a public offering.

articles.title: SK Hynix shares jump over 4% after early losses as chipmaker scraps Solidigm IPO plans
articles.preview: SK Hynix stock surged after canceling plans for Solidigm’s IPO. Investor concerns about the potential listing had previously weighed on the company’s shares.

summary.t: SK Hynix shares rose over 4% on Friday, reversing earlier losses of up to 3%. This jump occurred after the company decided to halt its review of Solidigm’s potential initial public offering (IPO).

Analyst Josh Gilbert stated that investor sentiment had been negatively affected by the possibility of a Solidigm IPO. He explained that the removal of this uncertainty would alleviate governance concerns and maintain Solidigm’s value within SK Hynix.

SK Hynix faces challenges in funding Solidigm’s growth, particularly as it seeks to build a new U.S. semiconductor fabrication plant. The company is exploring various financing options to meet growing demand for AI memory.

articles.title: Etsy bans AI-generated recipes and patterns from its online marketplace
articles.preview: Etsy also laid out clearer rules around AI usage on its platform, including barring sellers from creating bot-generated listings without any human involvement.

articles.title: Größter Tagesverlust seit Juni: KI-Sorgen setzen dem Nasdaq zu
articles.preview: Die US-Börsen erlitten heute ihren größten Rückgang seit Juni, getrieben von Sorgen über die Kosten des künftigen KI-Wettrüstens. Besonders Technologieaktien wurden stark belastet, während sich Anleger auf sicherere Anlagen verlegten.

summary.t: Der S&P 500 verzeichnete einen Rückgang von 1,21 Prozent auf 7663,43 Punkte, während der Nasdaq Composite um 2,6 Prozent auf 26008,86 Punkte fiel. Dies stellt den größten Tagesverlust seit Anfang Juni dar. Die Sorgen um die hohen Investitionen in Künstliche Intelligenz trugen maßgeblich zu dieser Entwicklung bei.

Meta Platforms verzeichnete einen Absturz von 7 Prozent, nachdem das Unternehmen zusätzliche Ausgaben in Milliardenhöhe bekannt gab. Auch die Aktien von SpaceX, Nvidia und CoreWeave sanken. Der PHLX Semiconductor Sector Index brach um 6,7 Prozent ein, was auf die allgemeine KI-Sorge zurückzuführen ist.
Nvidia-Chef Jensen Huang äußerte Bedenken hinsichtlich des Kapitalmangels für das Wachstum von Neoclouds.

articles.title: Meta stock sinks nearly 7% as AI spend pushes free cash flow negative
articles.preview: Meta’s stock experienced a significant drop on Thursday, and the company’s financial outlook raises concerns about its investment strategy.

summary.t: Meta reported negative free cash flow of $2.12 billion for the third quarter. The company’s full-year capital expenditures are now projected to be between $135 billion and $145 billion, an increase from the previous $130 billion estimate. Revenue increased by 26% to $64.60 billion.

articles.title: Marktbericht: SAP-Umbau trägt Früchte
articles.preview: SAP hat im dritten Quartal 2026 starke Ergebnisse vorgelegt, insbesondere im Cloud-Geschäft. Der Umbau des Unternehmens, der stark auf künstliche Intelligenz setzt, trägt Früchte.

summary.t: SAP meldete im dritten Quartal 2026 einen Umsatz von 10,3 Milliarden Euro. Der Umsatz stieg um 13 Prozent gegenüber dem Vorjahr. Das bereinigte operative Ergebnis (Ebit) betrug 3,03 Milliarden Euro, was eine Steigerung von 18 Prozent bedeutet. Der Gewinn wuchs um elf Prozent auf 2,27 Milliarden Euro.

Das Cloud-Geschäft von SAP verzeichnete ein starkes Wachstum. Die Cloudsoftware-Erlöse stiegen um 26 Prozent auf 26 Milliarden Euro. Die währungsbereinigte Steigerung der Cloud-Aufträge betrug 26 Prozent, mit einem Volumen von 24,1 Milliarden Euro. Der Umsatz der Cloud-Sparte stieg um 25 Prozent auf 6,67 Milliarden Euro.
SAP-Chef Christian Klein erwartet weiterhin ein Wachstum von 23 bis 25 Prozent für die Cloud-Erlöse, währungsbereinigt.

articles.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang says he sees no sign of a 2029 memory glut: 'You can always use more'
articles.preview: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang believes a memory glut won't materialize by 2029. He highlights the ongoing demand for memory and its potential for future expansion.

summary.t: Recent memory stock declines stemmed from a South Korean publication’s prediction of a significant supply surge by 2029. Two experts anticipated a ‘red ocean’ market, potentially signaling a downturn for the industry, including companies like SK Hynix, Samsung, and Micron.

Jensen Huang countered these concerns, stating that ‘you can always use more’ memory. He emphasized the continued importance of HBM and LPDDR memory for data center performance, citing Nvidia’s advancements in energy efficiency.

China’s advancements, particularly through CXMT’s new design architecture, are fueling investor concerns. Huang acknowledged China’s strength in fundamental infrastructure technology and stated Nvidia’s openness to potential partnerships with Chinese firms, including CXMT.
